---
title: "Code"
---

Ready-to-use implementations of the methods from my papers, so you can apply them to
your own data. These are method packages, not replication files. If you use one,
please cite the corresponding paper (each repository has a "How to cite" section).

### bubble-test-tv-volatility  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the wild-bootstrap sup-DF / sup-BZ / union test for explosive
bubbles that remains valid under time-varying volatility.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/bubble-test-tv-volatility](https://github.com/yang-zu/bubble-test-tv-volatility)
- Paper: Harvey, Leybourne and Zu (2019), *Econometric Reviews* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### dm-different-frequencies  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the two-sample test for comparing the accuracy of forecasts
observed at different sampling frequencies (e.g. a monthly forecast against a quarterly
one).

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/dm-different-frequencies](https://github.com/yang-zu/dm-different-frequencies)
- Paper: Zhang, Zu and Li, *Journal of Business and Economic Statistics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### truncated-andrews-bandwidth  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(R)</span>

R package implementing the truncated Andrews bandwidth for the CUSUM and QS mean-shift
tests, with Algorithm 1 for size-calibrated selection of the truncation threshold.
Install with `remotes::install_github("yang-zu/truncated-andrews-bandwidth")`.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/truncated-andrews-bandwidth](https://github.com/yang-zu/truncated-andrews-bandwidth)
- Paper: Li, Zhang and Zu, *Economics Letters* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### adaptive-cointegration-test  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(Ox)</span>

Ox implementation of the adaptive test for cointegration with nonstationary volatility:
the Johansen trace test and the spot-covariance-weighted adaptive LR test, each with
wild- and volatility-bootstrap p-values (bivariate system, no-cointegration null).

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/adaptive-cointegration-test](https://github.com/yang-zu/adaptive-cointegration-test)
- Paper: Boswijk and Zu (2022), *Journal of Business and Economic Statistics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### adaptive-unit-root-test  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(Ox)</span>

Ox implementation of the adaptive wild-bootstrap unit-root test (DF-GLS and adaptive LR,
robust to nonstationary volatility).

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/adaptive-unit-root-test](https://github.com/yang-zu/adaptive-unit-root-test)
- Paper: Boswijk and Zu (2018), *The Econometrics Journal* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### volatility-adjusted-dm  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the volatility-adjusted Diebold–Mariano tests for equal forecast
accuracy that remain valid under heteroskedasticity.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/volatility-adjusted-dm](https://github.com/yang-zu/volatility-adjusted-dm)
- Paper: Harvey, Leybourne and Zu (2024), *Journal of Applied Econometrics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### gdm-unstable-accuracy  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the generalized Diebold–Mariano test for equal *average* forecast
accuracy when relative accuracy varies over time.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/gdm-unstable-accuracy](https://github.com/yang-zu/gdm-unstable-accuracy)
- Paper: Harvey, Leybourne and Zu (2025), *Journal of Business and Economic Statistics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### sv-return-distribution-test  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the specification test for stochastic-volatility models based on
the return distribution (L2 density and Cramér–von Mises tests).

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/sv-return-distribution-test](https://github.com/yang-zu/sv-return-distribution-test)
- Paper: Zu and Boswijk (2017), *Journal of Empirical Finance* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### sv-volatility-density-test  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the specification test for stochastic-volatility models based on
the volatility density, recovered by deconvolution of squared returns (L2 tests against the
model spot-variance density and the stationary marginal), with optional GMM estimation.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/sv-volatility-density-test](https://github.com/yang-zu/sv-volatility-density-test)
- Paper: Zu (2015), *Journal of Econometrics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### spot-volatility-hf  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(Ox)</span>

Ox implementation of the noise-robust local two-scale (TSRV) spot-volatility estimator for
high-frequency prices, with a local realised-volatility estimator and data-driven tuning.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/spot-volatility-hf](https://github.com/yang-zu/spot-volatility-hf)
- Paper: Zu and Boswijk (2014), *Journal of Econometrics* — see [Research](research.qmd)

### variance-function-breaks  <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)">(MATLAB)</span>

MATLAB implementation of the truncated local-least-squares estimator of the innovation
variance function in autoregressions with structural breaks and explosive segments.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/variance-function-breaks](https://github.com/yang-zu/variance-function-breaks)
- Paper: Harvey, Leybourne and Zu (2023), *Journal of Time Series Analysis* — see [Research](research.qmd)
